# Albert Lea Apartments (A-Lea Apartments)

> A-Lea Apartments is a 71-unit, 3-building apartment complex in Albert Lea, Minnesota, offering 1 and 2 bedroom units with on-site laundry, off-street parking, and pet-friendly leasing (cat or dog, size restrictions apply, management approval required, 1 pet/unit). The complex is centrally located near shopping and a Kwik Trip, on a city bus route, roughly a 5 minute drive from anywhere in Albert Lea.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aleaapts.com/): overview, amenities, photo gallery, and office contact information.
